The appellate court will likely affirm, not reverse, because the man's own conduct—raising his gun and provoking the shootout rather than surrendering—caused the woman's death, bringing it within the felony-murder rule under the proximate-cause/agency reasoning. The correct choice is D: No, because the man started the flurry of shots instead of surrendering; he caused the woman's death and is guilty of first-degree murder.
